text:
mike: Heads-up — after flipping the new ingress routing policy for our VPC customers (fast-path header injection), we're seeing a spike in 5xx in eu-west-1 starting ~08:11 UTC. Recommending a surgical unwind: remove header injection and route back to legacy matcher for that stack. Anyone oncall who can run telemetry checks + toggle?

leah: I'll take it. Oncall and eng-sre pinged. Which toggle key?

mike: Key is route.fastpath_inject=true in gateway config. Config at infra/gateway/vpc.yml. Console toggle id is FORGE-INGRESS-FASTPATH. We can flip to false. There's also a fallback route precedence that should catch requests if header absent.

deploy-bot: @leah requested feature-toggle change FORGE-INGRESS-FASTPATH -> false. Approval required from eng-platform leads.

sam: I'm available. Any telemetry linking the 5xx to the header change specifically?

leah: Correlating traces: majority of 5xx are 503 from fastpath pool returning backend-unavailable. p95 spiked ~120ms above baseline. Rolling the console toggle is fastest to verify.

maria: Suggest we also add a temporary header rewrite (X-RW-Orig) to capture original values in logs before flipping, and lower fastpath precedence to reduce surface area.

leah: Two-step plan:
1) Console toggle FORGE-INGRESS-FASTPATH -> false
2) POST to internal API to set precedence:
```
POST /internal/routing/precedence
{
  "route": "vpc-fastpath",
  "precedence": 90
}
```
3) If 5xx > 1% for 3m, rollback immediately.

oncall-bot: @leah react :thumbsup: to proceed

leah: :thumbsup: flipping now.

deploy-bot: Toggle update triggered by leah at 08:21:12 UTC — change id xxy-334

leah: Done — propagation started 08:21:14. Starting smoke checks.

sam: Watching metrics…

sam: 08:23:00 — 5xx rate eu-west-1 dropping from 0.9% -> 0.15%, p95 returned to baseline. Traces look normal.

mike: Good catch. Can we mark this mitigated? Also update runbook: preference is precedence changes not header injection for vpc flows.

leah: Opening PR to docs/runbooks/ingress-toggle.md and will add follow-up issues: circuit-breaker for fastpath pool + alert update.

maria: Please add alert: fastpath-backend-health < 95% for 5m -> page.

leah: Will do. Closing out unless we see regression — last check 08:29:59 UTC.

mike: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for the follow-ups.
